instr: Letter patterns: study strings made by a hidden rule, then judge whether new strings follow the same rule.
clue: First study the letter strings on the screen; they all follow a hidden pattern. Then you will see new strings one at a time. Press the left arrow (or the left button) if a string follows the same pattern, the right arrow (or the right button) if it breaks it. Go with your first impression. Press Start when ready.
